ideas.topic: The Hidden Sound Inside a Pyramid Chamber
ideas.hook: You think the Great Pyramid is silent, but this chamber was actually designed to echo a specific frequency.
ideas.why: It leverages the curiosity-inducing 'auditory' angle seen in the popular 'mummy you can hear' video while maintaining your channel's calm, factual tone.

ideas.topic: Ancient Egyptian Makeup: More Than Just Beauty
ideas.hook: That iconic black eyeliner wasn't just for looks; it was a life-saving medical invention for the desert sun.
ideas.why: It follows the 'unexpected utility of ancient artifacts' pattern, appealing to viewers interested in the intersection of daily life and advanced ancient science.

ideas.topic: Why We Can't Rebuild the Great Pyramid Today
ideas.hook: Even with our modern technology, building the Great Pyramid today would be an engineering nightmare—here is why.
ideas.why: This addresses the 'impossible problem' trope that currently dominates the niche, but shifts the focus to a grounded, technical comparison that encourages comments.
